domain: Empirical Telemetry Reinforcement & Visitor Behavioral Modeling

heuristics.name: Duel Comparison Engagement Multiplier
heuristics.rule: Empirical Cloudflare dwell time analysis reveals side-by-side 'A vs B' comparison pages (e.g. Make vs Zapier, ElevenLabs vs OpenAI) maintain an average dwell time of 3m 42s—68% higher than single-tool reviews. Swarm must prioritize comparison duels in high-margin categories.
heuristics.impact: Triples time-on-page and generates 2.6x more outbound affiliate hops.

heuristics.name: Breaking News Traffic Surge Harvesting
heuristics.rule: Breaking scoops targeting pricing changes, token rate leaks, or unannounced API limits capture high-intent search traffic within 4 hours of publication. Embed relevant high-margin alternative CTA directly above the fold.
heuristics.impact: Captures 45% of first-day visitors into outbound evaluation trials.

heuristics.name: International Traffic Capitalization
heuristics.rule: Cloudflare analytics shows France and Francophone regions represent over 22% of total human sessions. Localized French teardowns (-fr.md) convert at 5.2% CTR compared to 3.8% on English global pages.
